passages.title: 第一次水肺潛水
passages.text: Last summer, my uncle took me scuba diving in Kenting for the first time. Before we went into the water, the coach taught us many safety rules. "Be {1} with your equipment," she said. "Check everything twice." She also gave each of us a {2} of fins. They looked like big duck feet! Then we went into the sea. At first, we stayed near the beach, but soon we swam into {3} water. Everything around me was blue and quiet. There were no {4} noises, only the sound of my own breathing. Suddenly, a sea turtle swam right next to me! I wanted to touch it, but I remembered the coach's words: "Never touch the animals. The sea {5} to them." I just watched it swim away slowly. It was the most beautiful moment of my life.

blanks.why: be careful with…「小心使用…」，後面說每樣東西都要檢查兩次。delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）、empty（空的）都不能和 with your equipment 搭配表示小心。
a pair of fins「一雙蛙鞋」，蛙鞋是兩隻一組。secret、bill、program 都不能用來數蛙鞋。
deeper water「更深的水」，從岸邊游到比較深的地方。cheaper（更便宜）、politer（更有禮貌）、emptier（更空）都不能形容海水的深淺。
loud noises「很大的噪音」，海裡只聽得到自己的呼吸聲。delicious、national、cheap 都不能形容聲音。
belong to…「屬於…」，大海是屬於動物的。repeats（重複）、types（打字）、boils（沸騰）都不能和 to them 搭配。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，舅舅第一次帶我去墾丁水肺潛水。下水之前，教練教了我們很多安全規則。「使用裝備要小心，」她說，「每樣東西都要檢查兩次。」她還發給我們每人一雙蛙鞋，看起來好像大大的鴨掌！接著我們下海了。一開始我們待在海灘附近，但很快就游到了比較深的地方。我身邊的一切都是藍色的，而且好安靜，沒有吵雜的聲音，只聽得到自己的呼吸聲。突然，一隻海龜就游到我旁邊！我很想摸摸牠，但我想起教練的話：「千萬不要碰動物，大海是屬於牠們的。」我只是看著牠慢慢游走。那是我人生中最美的一刻。

passages.title: 社區的中秋晚會
passages.text: Every year, our neighborhood holds a big Moon Festival {1} in the park. This year, I helped Mrs. Lee, our neighborhood chief, get ready for it. We put up lights, moved tables, and made a list of activities. There was a singing contest, a barbecue, and a game for kids. During the singing contest, Mr. Wu sang an old Taiwanese song. His voice was so {2} that even the people across the street could hear him. Everyone laughed and clapped. Then the kids played a game. They had to find the {3} between two pictures of the moon. My little sister found all five and won a box of mooncakes. At the end of the night, Mrs. Lee told everyone, "Please be {4} with the barbecue fire, and take your garbage home." I was tired, but it was a wonderful night. I felt that I really {5} to this neighborhood.

blanks.why: hold an event「舉辦活動」，社區在公園辦中秋活動。pair（一雙）、difference（不同）、secret（祕密）都不能用 hold 來「舉辦」。
so loud that…「大聲到…」，連對街的人都聽得到。careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）都不能形容聲音大小。
find the differences between…「找出…之間的不同」，比較兩張月亮的圖。pairs、secrets、bills 都不能和 between two pictures 搭配。
be careful with fire「小心用火」。delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能和 with the barbecue fire 搭配表示提醒。
belong to…「屬於…」，覺得自己是這個社區的一份子。repeated（重複）、typed（打字）、boiled（煮沸）都不能和 to this neighborhood 搭配。

passages.zh: 每年，我們社區都會在公園舉辦盛大的中秋活動。今年，我幫我們的里長李太太做準備。我們掛燈、搬桌子，還列出活動清單：有歌唱比賽、烤肉，還有給小朋友玩的遊戲。歌唱比賽時，吳先生唱了一首台語老歌，他的聲音大到連對街的人都聽得到，大家都笑著拍手。接著小朋友玩遊戲，要找出兩張月亮圖片的不同之處。我妹妹五個全部找到，贏了一盒月餅。晚會結束時，李太太提醒大家：「烤肉用火要小心，垃圾要帶回家。」我雖然很累，但那是很棒的一個晚上。我覺得自己真的是這個社區的一份子。

passages.title: 失物招領箱
passages.text: Our school has a big lost-and-found box near the office. It is full of things that students forgot: water bottles, jackets, and even a {1} of soccer shoes. Every month, our class leader, Hannah, puts up a list of the things. "If something {2} to you, please take it home," she writes. One day, I saw my old pencil case on the list. I lost it three months ago! Hannah asked me a few questions to make sure it was mine. "What's inside?" she asked. "Two blue pens and a green eraser," I said. She checked and smiled. "That's right." Hannah is very {3}. She never gives things to the wrong person. Our teacher says she is {4} for her age. Things that nobody takes are sold at a school {5} at the end of the year, and the money goes to children in need.

blanks.why: a pair of soccer shoes「一雙足球鞋」。secret、bill、program 都不能用來數鞋子。
belong to you「是你的（屬於你）」，就請帶回家。repeats、types、boils 都不能和 to you 搭配表示東西是誰的。
very careful「很細心」，所以從來不會把東西還錯人。loud（大聲的）和後一句沒有因果關係；delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）不能形容人。
wise for her age「以她的年紀來說很有智慧」。cheap（便宜的）、delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）都不能這樣稱讚人。
a school event「學校活動」，在活動上義賣。pair（一雙）、difference（不同）意思不通；knowledge 是不可數名詞，不能加 a。

passages.zh: 我們學校辦公室旁邊有一個很大的失物招領箱，裡面裝滿了同學忘記帶走的東西：水壺、外套，甚至還有一雙足球鞋。每個月，我們的班長 Hannah 都會貼出失物清單。「如果有東西是你的，請帶回家。」她寫道。有一天，我在清單上看到我的舊鉛筆盒，那是我三個月前弄丟的！Hannah 問了我幾個問題，確定那真的是我的。「裡面有什麼？」她問。「兩支藍筆和一個綠色橡皮擦。」我說。她檢查後笑了：「沒錯。」Hannah 非常細心，從來不會把東西還錯人。老師說以她的年紀來說，她很有智慧。沒人認領的東西會在學期末的學校活動中義賣，賣得的錢會捐給需要幫助的孩子。

passages.title: 跟著錄音念課文
passages.text: Our English teacher, Ms. Kao, believes that practice makes perfect. Every day, she plays a recording of our textbook and asks us to {1} after it. "Listen carefully, and then say it again," she says. At first, I thought it was boring. But after a month, I noticed a big {2}. My pronunciation was much better, and I could speak more smoothly. Ms. Kao also told us to read in a {3} voice. "Don't be shy. If you whisper, you can't hear your own mistakes," she said. Last week, our school held an English speaking {4} for ninth graders. I decided to join. I practiced every night and {5} the hard sentences many times. On the day of the contest, I wasn't nervous at all. I got second place! I want to thank Ms. Kao for her wise advice.

blanks.why: repeat after…「跟著…念」，聽完再說一次。belong 要接 to；boil（沸騰）、arrive（到達）都不能表示跟讀。
notice a big difference「發現很大的不同（進步）」，後面說發音變好了。pair、secret、bill 都不能說明這種改變。
in a loud voice「大聲地」，老師說不要害羞、不要小聲。wise（有智慧的）、cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）都不能形容念書的聲音。
an English speaking event「英語演說活動（比賽）」，後面說比賽當天。pair（一雙）、uniform（制服）、secret（祕密）都不能用 hold 來舉辦。
repeat the sentences「重複念句子」。belonged 是不及物動詞，要接 to；boiled、arrived 接 the hard sentences 都說不通。

passages.zh: 我們的英文老師高老師相信「熟能生巧」。她每天都播放課本的錄音，要我們跟著念。「仔細聽，然後再說一次。」她說。一開始我覺得很無聊，但一個月後，我發現了很大的不同：我的發音好多了，說起來也更流利。高老師還要我們大聲念。「不要害羞，如果你小聲念，就聽不到自己的錯誤。」她說。上星期，學校為九年級生舉辦了英語演說活動，我決定參加。我每天晚上都練習，把難的句子念了很多遍。比賽當天，我一點都不緊張，還得了第二名！我想謝謝高老師給我的明智建議。

passages.title: 電腦打字比賽
passages.text: Our school has a typing contest every year. This year, my friend Ethan wanted to win first prize. He practiced {1} every day after school. At first, he could only type twenty words a minute. His fingers were slow, and he often looked at the keyboard. His computer teacher gave him some {2} advice: "Don't look at your hands. Look at the screen, and be {3} with every letter." Ethan followed her advice. After three months, he could type sixty words a minute. On the day of the {4}, the room was very quiet. The only sound was the {5} clicking of keyboards. Ethan typed fast and made only two mistakes. He won first prize! "Practice really makes a difference," he said with a big smile.

blanks.why: practice + V-ing「練習做…」，練習打字。belonging、arriving、boiling 都不能當成練習的內容。
wise advice「明智的建議」。delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容建議。
be careful with every letter「每個字母都要小心」。delicious、loud（大聲的）、national 都不能和 with every letter 搭配表示小心。
the day of the event「比賽（活動）當天」。pair（一雙）、difference（不同）、secret（祕密）都不能指比賽。
the loud clicking「很大聲的喀噠聲」，教室裡只聽得到鍵盤聲。wise（有智慧的）、cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）都不能形容聲音。

passages.zh: 我們學校每年都有打字比賽。今年，我朋友 Ethan 很想得第一名。他每天放學後都練習打字。一開始，他一分鐘只能打二十個字，手指很慢，而且常常要看鍵盤。電腦老師給了他明智的建議：「不要看你的手，要看螢幕，每個字母都要小心打。」Ethan 照著她的建議做。三個月後，他一分鐘可以打六十個字。比賽當天，教室裡非常安靜，唯一的聲音是鍵盤很大聲的喀噠聲。Ethan 打得很快，只錯了兩個字。他得了第一名！「練習真的會帶來不同。」他笑得好開心。

passages.title: 找不同大挑戰
passages.text: My little brother Sam loves "spot the difference" games. In these games, there are two pictures that look the same, but there are five small {1} between them. Sam is only seven, but he is very {2}. He looks at every part of the pictures slowly. Last night, he showed me a new game in his book. In the first picture, a cat was sitting on a chair. In the second one, the cat was wearing a {3} of glasses! I found three differences quickly, but I couldn't find the last two. Sam {4} his favorite words: "Look slowly, and you'll see." He always says that. Finally, I found them: the cat's tail was shorter, and the clock showed a different time. Sam is a {5} little boy. He knows that hurrying doesn't help.

blanks.why: differences between them「它們之間的不同之處」，找不同遊戲就是要找這個。pairs、events、secrets 都不能和 between them 搭配。
very careful「很細心」，後面說他慢慢看每個地方。loud（大聲的）和後一句接不上；cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）不能形容人。
a pair of glasses「一副眼鏡」。secret、bill、program 都不能用來數眼鏡。
repeat his favorite words「重複他最愛說的話」，後面說他總是這麼說。belonged 要接 to；arrived、boiled 接 his favorite words 都說不通。
a wise little boy「有智慧的小男孩」，他懂得急也沒用。loud（大聲的）和後一句接不上；cheap、thick 不能形容人。

passages.zh: 我弟弟 Sam 很喜歡玩「找不同」遊戲。這種遊戲有兩張看起來一樣的圖，但它們之間有五個小小的不同。Sam 才七歲，但他非常細心，會慢慢看圖上的每個地方。昨晚，他給我看他書裡的一個新遊戲。第一張圖裡，有一隻貓坐在椅子上；第二張圖裡，那隻貓竟然戴著一副眼鏡！我很快就找到三個不同，但最後兩個怎麼找都找不到。Sam 重複他最愛說的話：「慢慢看，你就會看到。」他總是這樣說。最後我終於找到了：貓的尾巴比較短，時鐘上的時間也不一樣。Sam 是個有智慧的小男孩，他知道急也沒有用。

passages.title: 森林裡的老貓頭鷹
passages.text: Deep in the forest, there lived an old owl. All the animals said he was the {1} animal in the forest. When they had problems, they went to him for help. One day, a rabbit and a squirrel came to him. They were fighting about an apple. "I found it first, so it {2} to me!" said the rabbit. "No! It fell from my tree!" said the squirrel. Their voices were so {3} that all the birds flew away. The owl listened quietly. Then he asked them to {4} their stories one more time. After that, he cut the apple into two pieces of the same size. "Now there is no {5} between you," he said. "Each of you has half an apple." The rabbit and the squirrel looked at each other and laughed. They ate the apple together and became friends.

blanks.why: the wisest animal「最有智慧的動物」，所以大家有問題都去找他。loudest（最大聲）、cheapest（最便宜）、emptiest（最空）都不能說明大家為什麼找他幫忙。
It belongs to me.「它是我的」，兔子說蘋果是牠先發現的。repeats、types、boils 都不能和 to me 搭配表示東西屬於誰。
so loud that…「大聲到…」，鳥都被嚇飛了。wise（有智慧的）、cheap（便宜的）、careful（小心的）都不能形容吵架的聲音。
repeat their stories「把他們的說法再說一次」。belong 要接 to；arrive、boil 接 their stories 都說不通。
no difference between you「你們之間沒有差別」，兩個都分到一半。pair、event 意思不通；knowledge 也不能說明分得一樣多。

passages.zh: 在森林深處，住著一隻老貓頭鷹。所有動物都說他是森林裡最有智慧的動物，大家有問題時都會去找他幫忙。有一天，一隻兔子和一隻松鼠來找他，他們正為了一顆蘋果吵架。「是我先發現的，所以它是我的！」兔子說。「才不是！它是從我的樹上掉下來的！」松鼠說。他們的聲音大到把所有的鳥都嚇飛了。老貓頭鷹安靜地聽著，然後請他們把各自的說法再說一次。接著，他把蘋果切成一樣大的兩塊。「現在你們之間沒有差別了，」他說，「你們每人都有半顆蘋果。」兔子和松鼠看看彼此，都笑了。他們一起吃了蘋果，還成了好朋友。

passages.title: KTV 裡的麥克風
passages.text: For my cousin's birthday, our family went to KTV. My uncle took the microphone first. His voice was so {1} that the waiter came in to check if everything was okay. Then my grandma sang an old song from the 1960s. She sang it twice because she wanted to {2} her favorite part. My cousin and I chose a K-pop song. We practiced the dance moves for a week, so we knew every step. Our {3} of matching T-shirts made everyone laugh. It was interesting to see that everyone in my family likes a different {4} of music. Grandma likes old Taiwanese songs, my uncle likes rock, and we like K-pop. At the end of the night, the waiter brought the {5}. Dad looked at it and said, "It was worth every dollar."

blanks.why: so loud that…「大聲到…」，服務生還進來看看有沒有事。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、national（國家的）都不能形容唱歌的音量。
repeat her favorite part「重複唱她最愛的那一段」，所以唱了兩次。belong 要接 to；boil、arrive 接 her favorite part 都說不通。
a pair of matching T-shirts「一對一樣的 T 恤」，我和表姊各穿一件。bill、secret、program 都不能用來數衣服。
a different type of music「不同類型的音樂」，後面列出每個人喜歡的音樂。pair、event、secret 都不能和 of music 搭配表示種類。
bring the bill「拿帳單來」，爸爸看了說很值得。pair、type、difference 都不是服務生結帳時拿來的東西。

passages.zh: 表姊生日那天，我們全家去唱 KTV。舅舅第一個拿起麥克風，他的聲音大到服務生還進來看看有沒有事。接著奶奶唱了一首 1960 年代的老歌，她唱了兩次，因為她想再唱一次她最愛的那一段。我和表姊選了一首韓國流行歌，我們練了一個星期的舞步，每一步都很熟。我們兩個穿著一樣的 T 恤，讓大家都笑了。很有趣的是，我們家每個人喜歡的音樂類型都不一樣：奶奶喜歡台語老歌，舅舅喜歡搖滾樂，我們則喜歡韓國流行音樂。晚上結束時，服務生拿來了帳單。爸爸看了看說：「每一塊錢都很值得。」

passages.title: 不成對的襪子
passages.text: Every week, I help Mom with the laundry. My job is to put the socks into {1}. It sounds easy, but it isn't. There are always one or two socks without a partner. Where do they go? Last Saturday, I decided to solve the mystery. I was very {2}. I checked the washing machine, under the beds, and behind the sofa. Finally, I found the answer in our dog Lucky's bed. There were seven socks in it! "So they {3} to you now?" I asked Lucky. He looked at me with his big eyes and wagged his tail. Mom {4} when she saw the socks. Now we keep the socks in a box on a high shelf, and Lucky has a new {5} of toy: a rubber ball.

blanks.why: put the socks into pairs「把襪子配成一雙一雙」。events、differences、secrets 都不能用來整理襪子。
very careful「很仔細」，後面說我到處檢查。loud（大聲的）、cheap（便宜的）、delicious（美味的）都不能說明找東西的態度。
belong to you「屬於你」，襪子都被狗拿走了。repeat、type、boil 都不能和 to you 搭配表示屬於誰。
Mom laughed「媽媽笑了」。repeated、typed 後面需要受詞；belonged 要接 to。
a new type of toy「一種新的玩具」，冒號後面是橡膠球。pair 後面要接複數名詞，而且意思不通；difference、event 都不能和 of toy 搭配。

passages.zh: 我每個星期都幫媽媽處理洗好的衣服，我的工作是把襪子配成一雙一雙。聽起來很簡單，其實不然，因為總是有一兩隻襪子找不到另一半。它們到底跑去哪裡了？上星期六，我決定解開這個謎。我非常仔細，檢查了洗衣機、床底下和沙發後面。最後，我在我們家的狗 Lucky 的床上找到答案：裡面有七隻襪子！「所以它們現在是你的囉？」我問 Lucky。牠用大大的眼睛看著我，搖了搖尾巴。媽媽看到那些襪子也笑了。現在我們把襪子放在高架子上的盒子裡，而 Lucky 有了一種新玩具：一顆橡膠球。

passages.title: 爸爸的大嗓門
passages.text: My dad has a very {1} voice. When he talks on the phone, the whole building can hear him. When he calls me for dinner, I can hear him from the park across the street. But sometimes his voice is useful. Last month, at my school's sports {2}, Dad came to watch me run. In the last part of the race, I was tired and almost slowed down. Then I heard a voice: "GO, AMY, GO!" Everyone in the stadium turned to look at him. Dad kept {3} my name until I crossed the finish line. I came in first! After the race, my friends said, "Your dad is so funny." I felt a little embarrassed, but I also felt proud. Mom says there's a big {4} between being loud and being rude. Dad is loud, but he is never rude. He's also very {5}. He always knows the right thing to say when I'm sad.

blanks.why: a loud voice「大嗓門」，整棟樓都聽得到。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能說明為什麼大家都聽得到。
sports event「運動會（體育活動）」，爸爸來看我賽跑。pair、difference、secret 都不能和 sports 組成活動。
keep repeating my name「一直重複喊我的名字」。belonging 要接 to；typing（打字）不能在看台上喊；boiling 意思不通。
a difference between A and B「A 和 B 之間的不同」。pair、event、secret 都不能和 between being loud and being rude 搭配。
very wise「很有智慧」，總是知道該說什麼。cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）、empty（空的）都不能這樣稱讚人。

passages.zh: 我爸爸的嗓門很大。他講電話時，整棟樓都聽得到；他叫我吃晚餐時，我在對街的公園都聽得到。不過有時候他的大嗓門也很有用。上個月學校運動會，爸爸來看我賽跑。跑到最後一段時，我很累，差點就慢下來了。這時我聽到一個聲音：「衝啊，Amy，衝啊！」整個體育場的人都轉頭看他。爸爸一直喊我的名字，直到我衝過終點線。我跑了第一名！比賽結束後，朋友們說：「你爸好好笑喔。」我覺得有點尷尬，但也很驕傲。媽媽說，大聲和沒禮貌之間差很多。爸爸雖然大聲，但從來不會沒禮貌。他也很有智慧，每次我難過時，他總是知道該說什麼。

passages.title: 外婆的生活智慧
passages.text: My grandma never went to college, but she is the {1} person I know. She has an answer for every small problem at home. When my white shirt got a coffee stain, she put some lemon juice on it, and the stain disappeared. When our rice was too hard, she added a little water and cooked it again. "There are two {2} of people," she once told me. "Some people complain about problems. Others look for answers." Grandma is also very {3} with money. She writes down everything she buys in a small notebook. Last year, she used the money she saved to take the whole family to Japan! I asked her, "Grandma, how did you learn all these things?" She smiled. "Life is the best teacher. If you make a mistake, don't {4} it." That night, I {5} her words on my computer, so I would never forget them.

blanks.why: the wisest person「最有智慧的人」，後面說她什麼小問題都能解決。loudest（最大聲）、cheapest（最便宜）、emptiest（最空）都不能說明這一點。
two types of people「兩種人」，後面說明是哪兩種。events（活動）、bills（帳單）、secrets（祕密）都不能和 of people 搭配表示種類。
be careful with money「用錢很謹慎」，每樣東西都記帳。loud（大聲的）、delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）都不能和 with money 搭配。
don't repeat a mistake「不要重複犯錯」。belong 要接 to；boil（煮沸）、arrive（到達）接 it 都說不通。
type her words on my computer「把她的話打在電腦上」。belonged 要接 to；boiled、arrived 接 her words 都說不通。

passages.zh: 我外婆沒有上過大學，但她是我認識最有智慧的人。家裡的每個小問題她都有辦法解決。我的白襯衫沾到咖啡漬，她擠一點檸檬汁上去，污漬就不見了；飯煮得太硬，她加一點水再煮一次。「世界上有兩種人，」她有一次跟我說，「有些人抱怨問題，有些人找答案。」外婆用錢也很謹慎，她把買的每樣東西都記在一本小筆記本裡。去年，她用存下來的錢帶全家去日本玩！我問她：「外婆，這些事你是怎麼學會的？」她笑著說：「生活是最好的老師。犯了錯，就不要再犯第二次。」那天晚上，我把她的話打在電腦上，這樣我就永遠不會忘記。

passages.title: 深山裡的瀑布
passages.text: Last weekend, my family went hiking in the mountains of Yilan. We wanted to see a famous waterfall {1} in the forest. The path was narrow and wet, so Dad kept saying, "Be {2}. Don't run." After walking for two hours, we heard a {3} sound. "That's the waterfall!" my sister shouted. When we got there, the waterfall was even more beautiful than its photos. The water fell into a {4} pool. A sign said, "No swimming. This pool is dangerous." We sat on the rocks and ate our lunch while we listened to the water. Before we left, Mom said, "Nature doesn't {5} to us. We are only visitors here." So we picked up all our garbage and took it down the mountain with us.

blanks.why: deep in the forest「在森林深處」。loud、wise、careful 都不能和 in the forest 搭配表示位置。
Be careful.「要小心」，因為小路又窄又濕。deep（深的）、delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）都不能用來提醒人注意安全。
a loud sound「很大的聲音」，就是瀑布的水聲。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容聲音。
a deep pool「很深的水潭」，所以禁止游泳。wise、polite（有禮貌的）、careful 都不能形容水潭。
belong to us「屬於我們」，大自然不是我們的，我們只是訪客。repeat、type、boil 都不能和 to us 搭配表示屬於誰。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們全家去宜蘭的山上健行，想去看一座藏在森林深處的有名瀑布。小路又窄又濕，所以爸爸一直說：「要小心，不要跑。」走了兩個小時後，我們聽到很大的聲音。「是瀑布！」妹妹大叫。到了那裡，瀑布比照片上還要美。水落進一個很深的水潭，旁邊的告示寫著：「禁止游泳，水潭危險。」我們坐在石頭上，一邊聽水聲一邊吃午餐。離開前，媽媽說：「大自然不屬於我們，我們只是來這裡的訪客。」所以我們把垃圾全部撿起來，一起帶下山。

passages.title: 這隻狗是誰的？
passages.text: On my way home from school, I saw a small brown dog sitting alone outside the convenience store. It had a red collar, so I knew it {1} to someone. It looked scared and hungry. I gave it some water and waited. Then I noticed a small tag on its collar with a phone number on it. I was {2} when I called the number, because I didn't want to say anything wrong. A woman answered, and when I told her about the dog, she started to cry. "That's Coffee! He ran away this morning!" she said. Twenty minutes later, she arrived with her son. The boy ran to the dog and gave him a big hug. Coffee barked in a {3} voice and wagged his tail. The woman thanked me again and again. "Many people walked past him, but you stopped. That makes a big {4}," she said. Before they left, she gave me a {5} of movie tickets as a thank-you gift.

blanks.why: belong to someone「是某人的（屬於某人）」，有項圈表示有主人。repeated、typed、boiled 都不能和 to someone 搭配表示屬於誰。
I was careful「我很小心」，怕說錯話。loud（大聲的）和後面的原因相反；deep（深的）、delicious（美味的）不能形容人打電話的態度。
in a loud voice「大聲地」叫。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、national（國家的）都不能形容狗叫聲。
make a big difference「有很大的影響（差別）」，你停下來幫忙很重要。pair、type、event 都不能和 make a big 組成這個片語。
a pair of movie tickets「兩張電影票」。secret、bill、program 都不能用來數電影票。

passages.zh: 放學回家的路上，我看到一隻棕色的小狗獨自坐在便利商店外面。牠戴著紅色項圈，所以我知道牠是有主人的。牠看起來又害怕又餓，我給牠一些水，陪牠等著。接著我發現項圈上有一個小名牌，上面有電話號碼。我打電話時很小心，因為我不想說錯話。一位女士接起電話，聽到我說小狗的事，她哭了出來。「那是咖啡！牠今天早上跑走了！」她說。二十分鐘後，她和兒子趕到了。小男孩衝過去緊緊抱住小狗，咖啡大聲叫著，還一直搖尾巴。那位女士一再向我道謝。「很多人從牠旁邊走過，但你停了下來，這差別很大。」她說。離開前，她送我兩張電影票當作謝禮。

passages.title: 尤達大師的訓練
passages.text: In the Star Wars movies, Yoda is a small green Jedi Master. He is about nine hundred years old and very {1}. In one movie, a young man named Luke goes to a swamp to learn from him. At first, Luke doesn't {2} Yoda because he looks so small and funny. But Yoda's training is hard. Luke has to run, jump, and lift rocks with his mind. When Luke's spaceship sinks into the {3} water, he says, "I can't lift it. It's too big." Yoda answers that size doesn't matter. Then the tiny master lifts the ship out of the water by himself. Luke can't believe his eyes. He learns that there is a big {4} between trying and really believing. Yoda also tells Luke to be {5}, because anger and fear can lead him to the dark side.

blanks.why: very wise「很有智慧」，他是活了九百年的絕地大師。loud（大聲的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能這樣形容他。
doesn't respect someone「不尊重（看不起）某人」，因為尤達看起來又小又好笑。repeat（重複）、type（打字）接 Yoda 都說不通；belong 要接 to。
the deep water「深水」，太空船沉進水裡。careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容水。
a difference between A and B「A 和 B 的差別」。pair、type、event 都不能和 between trying and really believing 搭配。
be careful「要小心」，因為憤怒和恐懼會把他帶向黑暗面。loud（大聲的）、cheap（便宜的）、deep（深的）都不能表示提醒。

passages.zh: 在《星際大戰》電影裡，尤達是一位綠色的小個子絕地大師。他大約九百歲，非常有智慧。在其中一部電影裡，一位叫路克的年輕人到沼澤去向他學習。一開始，路克並不尊重尤達，因為他看起來又小又好笑。但尤達的訓練很辛苦，路克要跑、要跳，還要用意念舉起石頭。路克的太空船沉進深水裡時，他說：「我舉不起來，它太大了。」尤達回答，大小並不重要。接著，這位小小的大師自己就把太空船從水裡舉了起來。路克簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛。他學到「嘗試」和「真正相信」之間有很大的差別。尤達也告訴路克要小心，因為憤怒和恐懼會把他帶向黑暗面。

passages.title: 科學週的水火箭比賽
passages.text: Every spring, our school has a Science Week. The most popular {1} is the water rocket contest. This year, my partner Joe and I worked as a {2}. We made our rocket from two plastic bottles. We had to be very {3} when we cut the bottles, because the edges were sharp. On the day of the contest, many students came to watch. When our rocket flew into the sky, everyone gave a {4} cheer. It flew eighty meters, but another team's rocket flew ninety. We lost by only ten meters. Our science teacher told us, "Small changes can make a big {5}. Next year, try adding a little more water." Joe and I are already planning our new rocket.

blanks.why: the most popular event「最受歡迎的活動」，就是水火箭比賽。pair（一對）、difference（不同）、bill（帳單）都不能指科學週的比賽。
work as a pair「兩人一組合作」。bill、secret、program 都不能和 work as a 搭配表示分組。
be careful when…「做…的時候要小心」，因為切口很利。loud（大聲的）、deep（深的）、delicious（美味的）都不能表示小心。
a loud cheer「大聲歡呼」。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、deep（深的）都不能形容觀眾的歡呼。
make a big difference「造成很大的差別」，一點小改變就有很大影響。pair、event、type 都不能和 make a big 組成這個片語。

passages.zh: 我們學校每年春天都有科學週，最受歡迎的活動是水火箭比賽。今年，我和夥伴 Joe 兩人一組。我們用兩個寶特瓶做火箭。剪瓶子的時候要非常小心，因為切口很利。比賽當天，很多同學來看。我們的火箭飛上天空時，大家都大聲歡呼。它飛了八十公尺，但另一隊的火箭飛了九十公尺，我們只輸了十公尺。自然老師跟我們說：「小小的改變就能造成很大的差別。明年試試看多加一點水。」Joe 和我已經在計畫我們的新火箭了。

passages.title: 一模一樣的雙胞胎
passages.text: My new classmates, Tina and Nina, are twins. They have the same long hair, the same glasses, and even the same {1} of school bag. On the first day of school, I couldn't tell the {2} between them. I called Tina "Nina" three times, and they both laughed. "Don't worry. Everyone does that," Tina said. Then I started to look more carefully. I noticed that Tina has a small mark under her left eye. Nina's voice is also a little {3}. When they talk, I can hear it. Last week, they played a trick on our teacher. They changed seats, and Tina answered questions as Nina. But our teacher was too {4} to be fooled. "Nice try, Tina," she said with a smile. The twins are different in other ways, too. Tina loves sports, but Nina likes to stay home and read. Still, they're the best {5} of friends I know.

blanks.why: the same type of school bag「同一款書包」。pair 後面要接複數名詞，而且書包不是成雙的；event、secret 都不能和 of school bag 搭配。
tell the difference between…「分辨…之間的不同」。pair、event、bill 都不能和 tell the ___ between them 搭配。
a little louder「大聲一點」，所以聽聲音就分得出來。wiser（更有智慧）、cheaper（更便宜）、emptier（更空）都不能形容說話的聲音。
too wise to be fooled「太聰明了，騙不了」。loud（大聲的）、cheap（便宜的）、empty（空的）都不能說明老師為什麼沒被騙。
the best pair of friends「最好的一對朋友」，兩人感情很好。bill、secret、program 都不能用來說「一對」朋友。

passages.zh: 我的新同學 Tina 和 Nina 是雙胞胎。她們有一樣的長髮、一樣的眼鏡，連書包都是同一款。開學第一天，我完全分不出她們誰是誰。我把 Tina 叫成「Nina」三次，她們兩個都笑了。「別擔心，大家都會這樣。」Tina 說。後來我開始看得更仔細，發現 Tina 的左眼下面有一顆小痣，Nina 的聲音也大一點，她們說話時我就聽得出來。上星期，她們捉弄了老師：兩人交換座位，Tina 假裝成 Nina 回答問題。但老師太聰明了，騙不了她。「想得美喔，Tina。」她笑著說。這對雙胞胎在其他地方也不一樣：Tina 愛運動，Nina 喜歡待在家看書。不過，她們是我認識最要好的一對朋友。

passages.title: 背九九乘法的妹妹
passages.text: My little sister Ruby is in second grade, and she has to learn the multiplication table. Every night, she sits at the table and {1} it again and again: "Two times two is four, two times three is six…" Her voice is so {2} that I can't do my homework in the next room. "Ruby, can you be a little quieter?" I asked. "No! My teacher says I have to say it out loud," she answered. One evening, she cried because she couldn't remember the sevens. I sat next to her and said, "Don't worry. Let's do it together." We made a song for the sevens and sang it every night. A week later, there was a big {3} in her test score: she got 100! Ruby was so happy that she made me a card. It said, "You are the {4} big sister in the world." Now the song {5} to both of us, and sometimes we still sing it together.

blanks.why: repeat it again and again「一遍又一遍地念」。belongs 要接 to；types（打字）不能用嘴巴念；boils（沸騰）意思不通。
so loud that…「大聲到…」，我在隔壁房間都沒辦法寫作業。wise（有智慧的）、cheap（便宜的）、careful（小心的）都不能說明為什麼吵到我。
a big difference in her test score「她的分數有很大的不同（進步）」，考了一百分。pair、event、type 都不能和 in her test score 搭配。
the wisest big sister「最有智慧的姊姊」，謝謝我想出唱歌的方法。thickest（最厚）、cheapest（最便宜）、emptiest（最空）都不能用來稱讚人。
belong to both of us「屬於我們兩個」，這首歌是我們一起編的。repeats、types、boils 都不能和 to both of us 搭配表示屬於誰。

passages.zh: 我妹妹 Ruby 讀小學二年級，她要背九九乘法表。每天晚上，她都坐在桌子前一遍又一遍地念：「二二得四，二三得六……」她的聲音大到我在隔壁房間都沒辦法寫作業。「Ruby，你可以小聲一點嗎？」我問。「不行！老師說要念出聲音來。」她回答。有一天晚上，她因為記不住七的乘法哭了。我坐在她旁邊說：「別擔心，我們一起來。」我們把七的乘法編成一首歌，每天晚上一起唱。一週後，她的考試分數有了很大的不同：她考了一百分！Ruby 開心到做了一張卡片給我，上面寫著：「你是全世界最有智慧的姊姊。」現在這首歌是屬於我們兩個的，有時候我們還會一起唱。

passages.title: 電影院裡講電話的人
passages.text: Last Sunday, my friend and I went to see a new superhero movie. The theater was full. Just before the most exciting part, a man behind us started talking on his phone. His voice was very {1}. "Yes, I'm at the movies. What? Say that again!" he said. He kept asking the other person to {2} everything. Many people turned around and looked at him, but he didn't stop. Finally, an old woman next to him said, "Excuse me, sir. This is a public place. It doesn't {3} only to you." The man's face turned red, and he put his phone away. After the movie, my friend said, "That woman was so brave." "She was also {4}," I said. "She didn't shout. She just said the right words." I learned that a few polite words can make a big {5}.

blanks.why: very loud「很大聲」，大家都轉頭看他。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容講電話的音量。
ask someone to repeat everything「要對方每句話都再說一次」，前面他說「再說一次」。belong 要接 to；boil、arrive 接 everything 都說不通。
belong only to you「只屬於你」，公共場所是大家的。repeat、type、boil 都不能和 to you 搭配表示屬於誰。
wise「有智慧的」，她沒有大吼，只說了對的話。loud（大聲的）和「她沒有大吼」相反；cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）不能稱讚人。
make a big difference「造成很大的不同」。pair、type、event 都不能和 make a big 組成這個片語。

passages.zh: 上星期天，我和朋友去看一部新的超級英雄電影。電影院坐滿了人。就在最精彩的部分之前，我們後面有一個男人開始講電話。他的聲音非常大：「對，我在看電影。什麼？再說一次！」他一直要對方每句話都再說一次。很多人轉頭看他，但他還是沒停。最後，他旁邊的一位老奶奶說：「先生，不好意思，這裡是公共場所，不是只屬於你一個人的。」那個男人臉都紅了，把手機收了起來。電影結束後，我朋友說：「那位奶奶好勇敢。」「她也很有智慧，」我說，「她沒有大吼，只是說了對的話。」我學到，幾句有禮貌的話就能帶來很大的不同。

passages.title: 阿公學注音打字
passages.text: My grandpa got a smartphone for his eightieth birthday. He wanted to send messages to his grandchildren, but he didn't know how to {1}. So I taught him to use Zhuyin. At first, he was very slow. He looked at every key for a long time and was {2} not to make mistakes. After a week, he sent me his first message: "Good night, my dear." I was so happy that I showed it to my whole class. Now Grandpa sends messages to our family group every morning. He likes to send the same {3} of picture: flowers with the words "Good morning." Sometimes he sends the same picture three times because he forgets. When I tell him, he just laughs and says, "Then I'm sending you three times more love." Grandma says the phone has made a big {4} in his life. He doesn't feel lonely anymore. I think Grandpa is {5}. He knows it's never too late to learn something new.

blanks.why: know how to type「知道怎麼打字」，才能傳訊息。belong 要接 to；arrive（到達）、boil（沸騰）都和傳訊息無關。
be careful not to…「小心不要…」，每個按鍵都看很久。loud（大聲的）、deep（深的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能和 not to make mistakes 搭配。
the same type of picture「同一種圖片」，冒號後面說是什麼圖。pair 後面要接複數名詞；event、bill 都不能和 of picture 搭配。
make a big difference in his life「讓他的生活大不相同」，他不再孤單了。pair、event、bill 都不能和 make a big ___ 搭配。
wise「有智慧的」，他知道學習永遠不嫌晚。loud（大聲的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都和後一句的意思接不上。

passages.zh: 阿公八十歲生日時收到一支智慧型手機。他想傳訊息給孫子們，但他不會打字，所以我教他用注音。一開始他打得很慢，每個按鍵都看很久，很小心不要打錯。一個星期後，他傳了第一則訊息給我：「晚安，親愛的。」我開心到拿給全班看。現在阿公每天早上都在家族群組傳訊息。他喜歡傳同一種圖片：花上面寫著「早安」。有時候他會忘記，同一張圖傳三次。我跟他說的時候，他只是笑著說：「那我就是傳了三倍的愛給你們。」阿嬤說這支手機讓阿公的生活大不相同，他不再覺得孤單了。我覺得阿公很有智慧，他知道學新東西永遠不嫌晚。

passages.title: 魔法學校的大聲咒
passages.text: At Willow Magic School, students learn a new spell every week. This week, Professor Moon taught us the Loud Spell. "With this spell, a soft sound becomes very {1}," she said. "Be {2} with it." My friend Max wasn't listening. He was drawing a dragon in his notebook. When it was his turn, he pointed his wand at a mouse and said the magic words. The mouse opened its mouth and made a tiny sound, but it was louder than thunder! Windows shook, and books fell off the shelves. Professor Moon quickly {3} the magic words backward, and the mouse was quiet again. "Max," she said, "a wand doesn't {4} in the hands of someone who doesn't listen." Max said sorry. Then he took a {5} breath and tried again. This time, he did it perfectly.

blanks.why: become very loud「變得很大聲」，這是「大聲咒」。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容聲音變大。
Be careful with it.「使用時要小心」。thick（厚的）、deep（深的）、delicious（美味的）都不能和 with it 搭配表示提醒。
repeat the words backward「把咒語倒著再念一次」，讓老鼠恢復安靜。belonged 要接 to；arrived、boiled 接 the magic words 都說不通。
belong in someone's hands「適合（屬於）某人手中」，不聽課的人不配拿魔杖。repeat、type、boil 都不能和 in the hands of 搭配。
take a deep breath「深呼吸」。national（國家的）、wise（有智慧的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能和 breath 搭配。

passages.zh: 在柳樹魔法學校，學生每個星期都要學一個新咒語。這個星期，月亮教授教我們「大聲咒」。「用了這個咒語，小小的聲音就會變得非常大，」她說，「使用時要小心。」我朋友 Max 沒在聽，他正在筆記本上畫一隻龍。輪到他的時候，他用魔杖指著一隻老鼠，念出咒語。老鼠張開嘴發出一點點聲音，卻比打雷還大聲！窗戶都在震動，書也從架子上掉了下來。月亮教授趕快把咒語倒著念一次，老鼠又安靜了下來。「Max，」她說，「不聽課的人不配拿魔杖。」Max 道了歉，然後深呼吸，再試一次。這一次，他做得完美無缺。

passages.title: 健忘的多莉
passages.text: Dory is a blue fish in the movie Finding Dory. She is friendly and funny, but she forgets things very quickly. Her friends often have to {1} things for her many times. One day, Dory suddenly remembers her parents. She wants to find them, so she swims across the {2} ocean with her friends Marlin and Nemo. Marlin is worried. "Be {3}, Dory!" he says again and again. On the way, Dory meets many new friends, like an octopus and a whale shark. Finally, she sees a long line of shells on the sand. Her parents put them there for years, hoping she would follow them home. When Dory finds her family, she learns that she {4} with them, but also with her friends. Dory forgets many things, but she is {5} in her own way. When one road is closed, she always finds another one.

blanks.why: repeat things「把事情再說一遍」，因為多莉很健忘。belong 要接 to 或 with；boil（沸騰）、arrive（到達）接 things 都說不通。
the deep ocean「深海；廣大的海洋」。wise（有智慧的）、polite（有禮貌的）、careful（小心的）都不能形容海洋。
Be careful!「要小心！」馬林很擔心。deep（深的）、delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）都不能用來提醒人注意安全。
belong with…「和…在一起才對；歸屬於…」，她的家人和朋友都是她的歸屬。repeats、types、boils 都不能和 with them 搭配表示歸屬。
wise in her own way「有她自己的智慧」，後面說她總能找到另一條路。loud（大聲的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都和後一句接不上。

passages.zh: 多莉是電影《海底總動員2：多莉去哪兒》裡的一隻藍色的魚。她友善又好笑，但忘東西忘得非常快，朋友們常常得把事情跟她說好多遍。有一天，多莉突然想起了她的爸媽。她想找到他們，於是和朋友馬林、尼莫一起游過深深的大海。馬林很擔心，一直說：「多莉，要小心！」一路上，多莉認識了很多新朋友，像是一隻章魚和一條鯨鯊。最後，她在沙地上看到一長排貝殼。她的爸媽好多年來一直把貝殼排在那裡，希望她能跟著回家。多莉找到家人後明白了：她屬於家人，也屬於她的朋友。多莉雖然會忘記很多事，但她有她自己的智慧：一條路走不通時，她總是能找到另一條。

passages.title: 龍舟賽的鼓手
passages.text: Every year, there is a big dragon boat race on the river near my home. It is the most exciting {1} of the summer. This year, my cousin Jack was the drummer on his team's boat. His job was to beat the drum in a {2}, strong rhythm so that everyone could row together. "It's not easy," Jack told me. "If I make a mistake, the whole boat slows down." Before the race, he practiced every day. He {3} the same beat thousands of times. On the day of the race, the river was full of boats. The water there is {4}, so everyone on the boats wore life jackets. When the race started, Jack beat the drum hard. His team won by only half a boat! After the race, Jack said that the {5} between winning and losing is teamwork.

blanks.why: the most exciting event「最刺激的活動」，指龍舟賽。pair（一對）、difference（不同）、bill（帳單）都不能指比賽。
a loud rhythm「響亮的節奏」，讓大家聽得到一起划。wise（有智慧的）、polite（有禮貌的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容鼓聲。
repeat the same beat「重複同樣的節拍」，練了幾千次。belonged 要接 to；boiled、arrived 接 the same beat 都說不通。
The water is deep.「水很深」，所以大家都穿救生衣。wise、polite、cheap 都不能形容河水。
the difference between A and B「A 和 B 的差別」，輸贏的差別在團隊合作。pair、event、type 都不能和 between winning and losing 搭配。

passages.zh: 每年，我家附近的河上都會舉辦盛大的龍舟比賽，這是夏天最刺激的活動。今年，我表哥 Jack 是他們隊上的鼓手。他的工作是打出響亮有力的節奏，讓大家能一起划。「這不簡單，」Jack 跟我說，「只要我打錯，整艘船就會慢下來。」比賽前，他每天都練習，同樣的節拍重複打了好幾千次。比賽當天，河上擠滿了船。那裡的河水很深，所以船上每個人都穿著救生衣。比賽一開始，Jack 就用力打鼓。他們隊只贏了半個船身！比賽結束後，Jack 說輸贏的差別就在於團隊合作。

passages.title: 血型和個性
passages.text: In Taiwan and Japan, many people believe that your blood {1} tells you about your personality. My friend Mia believes it very much. "You're Type A, so you're very {2} and you like rules," she told me. "I'm Type O, so I'm friendly and full of energy." But my science teacher says there is no real {3} in personality between people with different blood types. Scientists have done many studies, but they can't find any link. Mia didn't believe it. "Then why are all my Type B friends so {4}?" she asked. "They talk and laugh all the time!" Our teacher smiled and said, "Maybe you just remember the times they were noisy." I think our personalities come from our families and experiences, not our blood. Mia and I are very different, but we still make a great {5} of friends.

blanks.why: blood type「血型」。pair、event、bill 都不能和 blood 組成這個詞。
very careful「很細心、很謹慎」，後面說喜歡規則。thick（厚的）、delicious（美味的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人的個性。
no real difference「沒有真正的差別」，科學家找不到關聯。pair、event、bill 都不能和 in personality between… 搭配。
so loud「好吵、好大聲」，後面說他們一直說說笑笑。cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）、empty（空的）都不能形容愛說話的人。
a great pair of friends「很棒的一對朋友」。bill、secret、program 都不能用來說「一對」朋友。

passages.zh: 在台灣和日本，很多人相信血型可以看出一個人的個性。我朋友 Mia 就非常相信。「你是 A 型，所以你很謹慎，喜歡守規則，」她跟我說，「我是 O 型，所以我很友善、很有活力。」可是我們的自然老師說，不同血型的人在個性上並沒有真正的差別。科學家做過很多研究，都找不到兩者之間的關聯。Mia 不相信。「那為什麼我的 B 型朋友都那麼吵？」她問，「他們一天到晚都在說說笑笑！」老師笑著說：「也許你只記得他們吵鬧的時候。」我覺得我們的個性來自家庭和經歷，而不是血液。Mia 和我很不一樣，但我們還是很棒的一對好朋友。

passages.title: 一雙紅色毛手套
passages.text: Last winter, my grandma knitted me a {1} of red gloves. She is seventy-eight, and her eyes are not very good, so it took her two months. I wore them every day. One cold morning, I lost one of the gloves on the bus. I felt terrible. "Grandma worked so hard on them," I thought. After school, I went to the bus station and asked if anyone had found a red glove. The man in the office checked a big box. "Does this {2} to you?" he asked. It was my glove! I was so happy that I thanked him in a {3} voice. Everyone in the office turned to look at me. When I got home, I told Grandma the story. She laughed and said, "Next time, be more {4}, or I'll have to knit you ten more pairs!" Since then, I always put my gloves in a {5} pocket of my coat.

blanks.why: a pair of gloves「一雙手套」。bill、secret、program 都不能用來數手套。
belong to you「是你的」，問手套是不是我的。repeat、type、boil 都不能和 to you 搭配表示屬於誰。
in a loud voice「大聲地」，所以大家都轉頭看我。wise（有智慧的）、cheap（便宜的）、careful（小心的）都不能說明大家為什麼轉頭。
be more careful「更小心一點」，才不會再弄丟。loud、cheap 意思不通；deep 的比較級是 deeper，不能說 more deep。
a deep pocket「很深的口袋」，手套才不會掉出來。wise（有智慧的）、cheap（便宜的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容口袋。

passages.zh: 去年冬天，我奶奶幫我織了一雙紅色手套。她七十八歲了，眼睛不太好，所以花了兩個月才織好。我每天都戴著。有一天早上很冷，我在公車上掉了一隻手套，心裡很難過。「奶奶為了這雙手套那麼辛苦。」我想。放學後，我到公車站去問有沒有人撿到一隻紅色手套。辦公室裡的先生翻了翻一個大箱子。「這是你的嗎？」他問。那正是我的手套！我開心到大聲向他道謝，辦公室裡的每個人都轉頭看我。回到家後，我把這件事告訴奶奶。她笑著說：「下次要更小心，不然我得再幫你織十雙！」從那以後，我都把手套放在外套很深的口袋裡。

passages.title: 東京和台北的不同
passages.text: Last spring, my family went to Tokyo for a week. Tokyo and Taipei look similar in many ways, but I noticed some interesting {1}. First, Tokyo is very quiet. People on the subway don't talk on their phones, and nobody speaks in a {2} voice. Second, people in Tokyo are very {3} about garbage. There are almost no trash cans on the streets, so people carry their garbage home. Third, the convenience stores are different. In Taipei, you can pay your bills and buy train tickets at a convenience store. In Tokyo, there are so many {4} of rice balls and desserts. But one thing is the same: people in both cities are kind and helpful. When we got lost, a young woman walked with us for ten minutes to help us find our hotel. When I said "Thank you," she smiled and {5} it in Chinese: "Xie xie!"

blanks.why: some interesting differences「一些有趣的不同」，後面一一列出。pairs、events、bills 都不能說明兩個城市不一樣的地方。
in a loud voice「大聲地」，東京很安靜，沒人大聲說話。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容說話的音量。
be careful about garbage「對垃圾很謹慎」，會把垃圾帶回家。loud（大聲的）、deep（深的）、delicious（美味的）都不能和 about garbage 搭配。
many types of rice balls「很多種飯糰」。events、bills、secrets 都不能和 of rice balls 搭配表示種類。
repeat it in Chinese「用中文再說一次」，她回我「謝謝」。belonged 要接 to；arrived、boiled 接 it 都說不通。

passages.zh: 去年春天，我們全家去東京玩了一個星期。東京和台北在很多地方看起來很像，但我發現了一些有趣的不同。第一，東京很安靜。地鐵上的人不講電話，也沒有人大聲說話。第二，東京人對垃圾很謹慎。街上幾乎沒有垃圾桶，所以大家都把垃圾帶回家。第三，便利商店不一樣。在台北，你可以在便利商店繳帳單、買火車票；在東京，便利商店有好多種飯糰和甜點。不過有一件事是一樣的：兩個城市的人都很親切、很樂於助人。我們迷路的時候，一位年輕女生陪我們走了十分鐘，幫我們找到飯店。我跟她說「Thank you」時，她笑著用中文再說了一次：「謝謝！」

passages.title: 屬於大家的公園
passages.text: There is a small park near my apartment. In the past, it was dirty. People threw garbage on the grass, and dogs left their poop everywhere. One day, Mrs. Chang, an old lady in our building, decided to change it. She put up a sign: "This park {1} to all of us. Please keep it clean." Then she started an {2} called "Clean Park Sunday." Every Sunday morning, she invited neighbors to pick up garbage together. At first, only three people came, but Mrs. Chang didn't give up. She kept {3} her invitation at every building meeting. After six months, more than thirty people joined. Now the park is clean and beautiful. Kids play on the grass, and dog owners are more {4}. They always clean up after their dogs. Mrs. Chang showed us that one person can make a big {5}.

blanks.why: belong to all of us「屬於我們大家」。repeats、types、boils 都不能和 to all of us 搭配表示屬於誰。
start an event「發起一個活動」，叫做「乾淨公園星期天」。pair、bill 意思不通；difference 也不能取名字、邀人參加。
keep repeating her invitation「一再提出她的邀請」。belonging 要接 to；arriving、boiling 接 her invitation 都說不通。
more careful「更小心、更注意」，會清理狗的大便。loud、cheap 的比較級不是 more ___；deep 也不能形容狗主人。
make a big difference「帶來很大的改變」。pair、event、type 都不能和 make a big 組成這個片語。

passages.zh: 我家公寓附近有一座小公園，以前那裡很髒，有人把垃圾丟在草地上，狗的大便也到處都是。有一天，我們大樓裡的張奶奶決定改變這一切。她立了一個牌子：「這座公園屬於我們大家，請保持乾淨。」接著，她發起了一個叫做「乾淨公園星期天」的活動，每個星期天早上邀請鄰居一起撿垃圾。一開始只有三個人來，但張奶奶沒有放棄，每次大樓開會她都一再邀請大家。六個月後，參加的人超過三十個。現在公園又乾淨又漂亮，小朋友在草地上玩，狗主人也更注意了，總是會清理狗的大便。張奶奶讓我們知道，一個人也能帶來很大的改變。

passages.title: 英文歌唱比賽的低音
passages.text: Our class joined the school's English song contest this year. We chose an old Beatles song. Our music teacher said we needed a boy with a {1} voice for the low part. Everyone looked at Leo. He is quiet and shy, but his voice is low like a bear's. At first, Leo said no. "I can't sing in front of people," he said. But we told him that the low part {2} to him, because nobody else could sing it. Finally, he agreed. We practiced every day after lunch. Our teacher made us {3} the hard part twenty times. "Be {4} with the high notes," she told the girls. On the day of the contest, Leo stood in the middle. When he sang his part, the hall was quiet. Then everyone gave a {5} cheer. We won second prize, and Leo became the star of our class.

blanks.why: a deep voice「低沉的聲音」，後面說他聲音低得像熊。cheap（便宜的）、polite（有禮貌的）、careful（小心的）都不能形容聲音的高低。
belong to him「是屬於他的」，只有他唱得來。repeated、typed、boiled 都不能和 to him 搭配表示屬於誰。
make us repeat the hard part「要我們把難的部分重複練」。belong 要接 to；boil、arrive 接 the hard part 都說不通。
be careful with the high notes「唱高音要小心」。thick（厚的）、cheap（便宜的）、deep（深的）都不能和 with the high notes 搭配表示提醒。
a loud cheer「大聲歡呼」。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、national（國家的）都不能形容歡呼聲。

passages.zh: 今年我們班參加了學校的英文歌唱比賽，我們選了一首披頭四的老歌。音樂老師說，低音的部分需要一個聲音低沉的男生。大家都看向 Leo。他安靜又害羞，但他的聲音低得像熊一樣。一開始 Leo 拒絕了。「我沒辦法在大家面前唱歌。」他說。但我們跟他說，低音部分非他莫屬，因為沒有其他人唱得來。最後他答應了。我們每天午餐後都練習，老師要我們把難的部分重複練了二十次。「唱高音的時候要小心。」她提醒女生們。比賽當天，Leo 站在正中間。他唱他那一段時，整個禮堂都安靜下來，接著大家大聲歡呼。我們得了第二名，Leo 也成了我們班的明星。

passages.title: 海邊撿到的瓶中信
passages.text: While walking on the beach in Taitung, my brother and I found a glass bottle with a letter inside. We were {1} when we opened it because the paper was old. The letter was {2} in English, not written by hand. It said, "Hello! My name is Emma. I'm twelve, and I live in the Philippines. If you find this, please write to me." There was an email address at the bottom. We were so excited. How did a small bottle travel across the {3} sea to Taiwan? That night, we wrote an email to Emma. Two days later, she wrote back! She said she put the bottle in the sea two years ago at a school {4} about the ocean. Now we write to each other every week. There are many {5} between our lives, but we both love the sea and cats.

blanks.why: We were careful「我們很小心」，因為紙很舊。loud（大聲的）、deep（深的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能說明打開瓶子時的態度。
be typed「用打字的」，和後面「不是手寫」相對。belonged 不能用被動；repeated（被重複）、boiled（被煮）都不能說明信是怎麼寫的。
the deep sea「深深的大海」。wise（有智慧的）、polite（有禮貌的）、careful（小心的）都不能形容海。
a school event「學校活動」，主題是海洋。pair（一對）、difference（不同）、bill（帳單）都不能指學校舉辦的活動。
many differences between…「…之間有很多不同」，後面用 but 說兩人的共同點。pairs、events、bills 都不能和 between our lives 搭配。

passages.zh: 我和弟弟在台東的海邊散步時，撿到一個裝著信的玻璃瓶。紙很舊，所以我們打開時很小心。信是用英文打字的，不是手寫的，上面寫著：「你好！我叫 Emma，今年十二歲，住在菲律賓。如果你撿到這封信，請寫信給我。」信的最下面有一個電子郵件地址。我們好興奮。一個小瓶子是怎麼漂過深深的大海來到台灣的呢？那天晚上，我們寫了一封電子郵件給 Emma。兩天後，她回信了！她說那是兩年前，她在學校一場關於海洋的活動中把瓶子丟進海裡的。現在我們每個星期都寫信給對方。我們的生活有很多不同，但我們都喜歡大海和貓。

passages.title: 座頭鯨的歌聲
passages.text: Humpback whales are famous for their songs. Their songs can be very {1}, sometimes louder than a jet plane! The sound can travel far in the {2} ocean, so whales can hear each other from many kilometers away. Scientists have found something interesting: male whales in the same area sing the same song. They {3} it again and again, sometimes for hours. Every year, the song changes a little, so there are small {4} between this year's song and last year's song. No one knows exactly why. Maybe the whales just like new music, like we do. Scientists have to be very {5} when they study whales, because boats and noise can scare them away. Maybe one day we will understand what the whales are singing about.

blanks.why: very loud「非常大聲」，後面說比噴射機還大聲。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容聲音。
the deep ocean「深海」。polite（有禮貌的）、careful（小心的）、wise（有智慧的）都不能形容海洋。
repeat it again and again「一再重複唱」。belong 要接 to；boil、arrive 接 it 都說不通。
small differences between…「…之間的小差異」，歌每年都會改變一點。pairs、events、bills 都不能和 between this year's song and last year's song 搭配。
be careful「要小心」，因為船和噪音會嚇跑鯨魚。loud（大聲的）正好會嚇跑鯨魚；cheap（便宜的）、deep（深的）都不能形容科學家的態度。

passages.zh: 座頭鯨以牠們的歌聲聞名。牠們的歌聲可以非常大聲，有時候比噴射機還響！聲音在深海裡可以傳得很遠，所以鯨魚在好幾公里外也聽得到彼此。科學家發現了一件有趣的事：同一個海域的雄鯨會唱同一首歌，牠們一再重複地唱，有時候一唱就是好幾個小時。每年，這首歌都會改變一點，所以今年的歌和去年的歌之間有一些小差異，沒有人知道確切的原因，也許鯨魚就跟我們一樣，喜歡聽新歌。科學家研究鯨魚時必須非常小心，因為船隻和噪音會把牠們嚇跑。也許有一天，我們會知道鯨魚到底在唱些什麼。

passages.title: 聰明的縣太爺
passages.text: Long ago, an oil seller and a farmer came to the town judge. They were fighting over a bag of coins. "These coins {1} to me!" they both shouted. Their voices were so {2} that people on the street came to watch. The judge was a {3} old man. He listened to both men and then asked each of them to {4} his story one more time. Then he asked for a bowl of hot water and put the coins in it. After a few minutes, a little oil appeared on top of the water. "You see," the judge said, "these coins came from someone who touches oil every day. They belong to the oil seller." The farmer's face turned red. He had stolen the bag. Everyone in the crowd cheered. They said their judge could always see the {5} between the truth and a lie.

blanks.why: belong to me「是我的」，兩個人都說錢是自己的。repeat、type、boil 都不能和 to me 搭配表示屬於誰。
so loud that…「大聲到…」，街上的人都跑來看。wise（有智慧的）、careful（小心的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容吵架的聲音。
a wise old man「一位有智慧的老人」，後面他想出好辦法。loud（大聲的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能這樣形容縣官。
repeat his story「把他的說法再說一次」。belong 要接 to；arrive、boil 接 his story 都說不通。
see the difference between A and B「分辨 A 和 B 的不同」，看得出真話和謊話。pair、event、bill 都不能和 between the truth and a lie 搭配。

passages.zh: 很久以前，一個賣油的人和一個農夫來找縣太爺。他們為了一袋錢在吵架。「這些錢是我的！」兩個人都大喊。他們的聲音大到街上的人都跑來看熱鬧。縣太爺是一位很有智慧的老人。他聽完兩個人的話，又請他們各自把自己的說法再說一次。接著，他叫人拿來一碗熱水，把錢幣放進去。過了幾分鐘，水面上浮出了一點油。「你們看，」縣太爺說，「這些錢是一個每天都碰油的人的，所以它們是賣油的人的。」農夫的臉一下子紅了，原來是他偷了那袋錢。圍觀的人群都歡呼起來，說他們的縣太爺總是分得出真話和謊話。
